response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS mean_group_average, AVG(g.group_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_above_baseline FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.group_avg > b.baseline_avg

assumptions.assumption: A timing group with no non-null institutional ownership values has no defined average and is excluded from the baseline.
